plain: While being questioned at a missile site in South Dakota, a nuclear weapons guard went to the restroom and suddenly heard a ringing in his ears "as if somebody struck a Liberty Bell right next to my head", then saw a green light and felt he had left his body. The guard, a former Air Force man named Mario Woods, tells it himself on three episodes and names a Master Sergeant Gray in it. The story places it in the 1960s, but in two tellings Woods dates it to November 1977 at a launch control site called November-1, and one of those leaves out the green light. He tells it as part of an alien abduction.
